key.name: round-libadwaita-apps
key.summary: Round libadwaita apps like any other app

key.name: round-libhandy-apps
key.summary: Round libhandy apps like any other app

key.name: round-maximized
key.summary: Keep maximized and tiled windows rounded

key.name: use-whitelist
key.summary: Round only the apps in the whitelist, instead of all apps but those in the blacklist

key.name: blacklist
key.summary: Desktop IDs of the apps that are not rounded

key.name: whitelist
key.summary: Desktop IDs of the only apps that are rounded

key.name: blacklist-categories
key.summary: Toolkits whose apps are not rounded, named as in styled-categories

key.name: whitelist-categories
key.summary: Toolkits whose apps are the only ones rounded besides the whitelist, named as in styled-categories

key.name: styled-apps
key.summary: Desktop IDs of the apps with a style of their own, each stored under apps/ID/

key.name: styled-categories
key.summary: Toolkits whose apps share a style of their own, each stored under categories/TOOLKIT/
key.description: Toolkits: libadwaita, libhandy, chromium, firefox, java, qt, gtk4 and gtk3.

key.name: custom-style
key.summary: Use the values below instead of libadwaita's style and gtk.css

key.name: outline-width
key.summary: Width of the outline inside the window's edge, in pixels

key.name: outline-color
key.summary: Color of the outline, as CSS

key.name: shadow-strength
key.summary: Strength of libadwaita's shadow, 1 being libadwaita's own

key.name: border-method
key.summary: How the app's own border is hidden: not at all, covered by the pixels next to it, or cut off

key.name: border-width
key.summary: Width of the app's own border, in pixels
